scenes.say: Your AI model is brilliant, but it's stuck in a box. It can't open your files, run your tools, or touch your browser.

scenes.heading: Every app, wired to every tool
scenes.say: So every app wires up every tool by hand. Five apps, five tools: twenty five integrations.

scenes.heading: One protocol in the middle
scenes.say: MCP puts one standard in the middle. Build a server once, and any app that speaks MCP can use it.
Underneath, it's plain JSON-RPC: standard input for local servers, HTTP for remote ones.

scenes.command: claude mcp add kaviri -- kaviri mcp
scenes.say: Here's a real one. One line adds kaviri's MCP server to Claude Code.

scenes.label: kaviri · filming a demo
scenes.say: Now the model can open a browser, click around, and film the demo for you.

scenes.text:
Write it *once*.
Every AI app
can use it.
scenes.say: That's MCP. Write it once, and every AI app can use it.
